attributes.board_name: Puerto Rico Department of Health, Oficina de Reglamentación y Certificación de los Profesionales de la Salud (no MFT board)

rules.alternatives: Clinicians who provide couple and family therapy in Puerto Rico do so under another licence (e.g. professional counselor, psychologist or social worker) and must meet that board's CE rules.
rules.notes: Puerto Rico does not license marriage and family therapists as a separate profession, so no state MFT CE applies. The Department of Health's list of examining boards (Juntas Examinadoras) has no marriage and family therapy board, and none of the examining boards attached to the Department of State (Ley 41-1991, Art. 1) covers it.
rules.legal_basis: Ley Núm. 41 de 5 de agosto de 1991, Art. 1 (boards attached to the Department of State); Department of Health list of examining boards
